rationale.elig-residency: Eligibility §3.2 says 'Applicants must be an Australian citizen or have permanent residency status.'; citizenship and NT residence are evidenced on pp.12 and 16.
rationale.elig-property: Eligibility §3.1.1 says 'applicants and tenants who own or partly own residential property anywhere in Australia are ineligible for social housing.'; pp.6 and 19 show no property interest.
rationale.elig-income: Identification and Documentation §3.2 says 'The CEO (Housing) requires evidence of income and assets to determine eligibility for social housing, private rental bond assistance, and to calculate rent.'; pp.56–58 show income evidence requested but not received.
rationale.elig-debts: Eligibility §3.4 says 'The provision of social housing will not be withheld based on a debt owed to the CEO (Housing).'; p.8 is a January snapshot and p.23 shows the debt cleared.
rationale.elig-former-tenancy: Eligibility §3.5 refers to 'termination (under breach of tenancy agreement conditions or satisfactory tenancy criteria)'; p.30 records mutual agreement and no breach.
rationale.prio-category: Priority §3 lists 'Domestic or family violence.' as an urgent-need category; p.51 documents the family's flight from violence.
rationale.prio-documentation: Priority §3.1 says 'Applicants must prove their urgent need for priority housing and are required to provide documentation that supports their claim for priority.'; p.51 is the support-service evidence.
rationale.prio-discretion: Priority §3.1 allows 'some discretion for extreme situations'; pp.6, 12, 16, 19, 23, 30 and 51 establish no requested exception, so this clause is not applicable.
